sn35.245:2.2: “Reverend, at what point is a mendicant’s vision well purified?”
sn35.245:3.1: Not content with that answer, that mendicant went up to a series of other mendicants and received the following answers:
sn35.245:3.2: “Reverend, at what point is a mendicant’s vision well purified?”
sn35.245:4.1: Not content with that answer, that mendicant went up to a series of other mendicants and received the following answers:
sn35.245:4.2: “Reverend, at what point is a mendicant’s vision well purified?”
sn35.245:5.2: ‘Reverend, at what point is a mendicant’s vision well purified?’
sn35.245:5.3: When this was said, sir, that mendicant said to me:
sn35.245:5.4: ‘When a mendicant truly understands the origin and disappearance of the six fields of contact, at that point their vision is well purified.’
sn35.245:5.5: Not content with that answer, sir, I went up to another mendicant and said to him:
sn35.245:5.6: ‘Reverend, at what point is a mendicant’s vision well purified?’
sn35.245:5.7: When this was said, sir, that mendicant said to me:
sn35.245:5.8: ‘When a mendicant, with regard to the five grasping aggregates …
sn35.245:5.9: truly understands the origin and disappearance of the four principal states …
sn35.245:5.10: truly understands that everything that is liable to arise is liable to cease, at that point their vision is well purified.’
sn35.245:5.11: Not content with that answer, sir, I went up to the Buddha (…).
sn35.245:7.2: ‘My man, what’s a parrot tree like?’
sn35.245:7.5: Now, at that time a parrot tree may well have been just as that person saw it.
sn35.245:7.6: Not content with that answer, that person would go up to a series of other people and receive the following answers:
sn35.245:7.7: ‘My man, what’s a parrot tree like?’
sn35.245:7.10: Now, at that time a parrot tree may well have been just as that person saw it.
sn35.245:7.11: Not content with that answer, that person would go up to a series of other people and receive the following answers:
sn35.245:7.12: ‘My man, what’s a parrot tree like?’
sn35.245:8.11: ‘Worthy man, where is the lord of the city?’
sn35.245:8.13: ‘There he is, sirs, seated at the central square.’
